findings.message: Homepage lacks a hero-scale product/system visual in the first viewport.
findings.evidence: main_hero_visual_above_fold_count=0
findings.remediation: Add a hero-scale product screenshot, architecture diagram, or governed-flow visual inside <main> above the fold (see Product Visual Requirement in docs/design/forge-enterprise-ai-website-standard.md). Do not satisfy this finding by rewriting Markdown hero copy alone—allocate a visual slot in the landing layout first.

findings.message: No CTAs detected above the fold while the trust model is also insufficiently explicit.
findings.evidence: 1 trust terms; no matched CTA verbs above fold.
findings.remediation: Add one primary action, one secondary action, and a concise trust block (boundaries, control, evidence) above the fold.

findings.message: The page does not clearly show where it fits in the Forge ecosystem.
findings.evidence: 0 ecosystem terms detected.
findings.remediation: Add an ecosystem strip linking ForgeSDLC, Lenses, LCDL, Fleet, Platform, and Blueprints where relevant.

findings.message: The page may be mechanism-led rather than outcome-led.
findings.evidence: 1 outcome terms detected.
findings.remediation: Rewrite section headings and cards around user outcomes before mechanisms.

findings.message: Meta description is missing or too short.
findings.evidence: No meta description found.
findings.remediation: Add a 120-160 character description that states what the product is and why it matters.

findings.remediation: Remove inline hash/data-ks-* attribute strings; use `ks_hash_attrs()` or `layout_shell_attrs` / `page_main_attrs` / `chrome_region_attrs` from `components/ks_catalog_hashes.py`.
